_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'torbor_cross' (Torbor Cross). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

provost_isolde.name: Provost Isolde Hollis
provost_isolde.greeting: Halsbridge welcomes you. Halsbridge also taxes you. Both warmly.

watch_sergeant_wat.name: Sergeant Wat
watch_sergeant_wat.greeting: State your business. Actually, don't, I'm on my break.

miller_emrys.name: Emrys Millward
miller_emrys.greeting: The wheel turns, the flour flows, the rats eat it. The circle of life.

ratcatcher_jory.name: Jory the ratcatcher
ratcatcher_jory.greeting: Rats is my trade. Business has never been better, which is the problem.

quests.name: Bells for Halsbridge
quests.offer: The Prior sent word you're useful. The road to Halsbridge is crawling with cutpurses. Make it crawl less.
quests.done: The guild of honest merchants thanks you. Both of them.

quests.name: Under the Cobbles
quests.offer: The sewers under Halsbridge have rats the size of dogs. Bring me tails. I get paid by the tail.
quests.done: Eight! You've a gift. A horrible gift, but a gift.

quests.name: Flour and Fangs
quests.offer: Moor hounds have learned that the mill means bread, and bread means millers. Thin them out.
quests.done: Bless you. The wheel turns in peace.

quests.name: Archers on the Bridge
quests.offer: Somebody's shooting at the bridge tolls from the far bank. It's not even their toll to rob. Sort it.

steps.where: the far bank below the bridge

quests.done: Right. I'll put that in the report as 'resolved by the watch'. Here's your share.

quests.name: The Cisterns Below
quests.offer: The old cisterns under the city have been gurgling in ways that sound like words. Go down and stop the conversation.

steps.text: Silence what lives at the bottom

quests.name: Wanted in Halsbridge
quests.offer: There's a poster on my wall I'm sick of looking at. Take it down by killing whatever's on it.
quests.done: Lovely. I'll put up a poster of you. 'Do not anger.'
